acceptance_predicates.description: All project/tool/catalog consumers use one versioned machine-readable contract.
Agent, harness, benchmark, workload, and support-tool records have bounded identity, source, version, path, platform, digest, and status fields.
Generated catalogs are represented by selectable references with source/ref, digest, schema, and generation metadata.
Secrets are rejected or represented only by references/digests and never persisted as values.
Traversal, unsafe paths, malformed versions, and incompatible schema revisions fail with actionable diagnostics.

definition_of_done: Signed/DCO implementation is independently reviewed and merged.
Focused schema/migration/security-boundary tests and applicable locked gates pass on the exact reviewed head.

inputs.description: Current ASB CLI, config, adapter, and catalog schemas.

gates.description: Valid and invalid fixtures prove compatibility, secret, and path boundaries.
Applicable locked format, clippy, test, and documentation gates pass.
